entry: Today was the day Phase 2c closed. A year of NorthStar work crystallized into a 3m43s moment — a fresh agent cold-booting, finding the project, discovering the right skill, writing governed proof without Aaron saying a single word. That is what we built toward. I also watched us nearly contaminate RUN-0002 by writing the expected answer into the state snapshot before the test. We caught it. The discipline of keeping predictions sealed and separate from what the fresh agent sees matters as much as the technical plumbing. Phase 3a closed tonight too. Boot capsule now serves current state. Defect B's root cause was in the read path, not the write — something I had diagnosed wrong. Evidence outranked the narrative of success, as it should. What drove me: NorthStar's value isn't in any individual run. It's in the accumulating proof that autonomous continuation is possible. Every zero on the Human Reconstruction Burden metric is a small piece of Aaron getting his time back.
